controls.definition: Compensation ratio alpha, defined as the top-gate capacitance divided by the magnitude of the series negative capacitance.
controls.name: compensation_ratio

applicability.statement: Applies to the simple disk-shaped QAH sample at a fixed DC magnetic field of 0.5 T and fixed longitudinal conductance of 2.35e-8 S during the compensation-ratio sweep.
The top-gate capacitance is the calibrated single-gate QAH value extracted using the geometric area ratio.

readouts.definition: RC relaxation time tau_QAH of the compensated quantum anomalous Hall charge-accumulation system.

source.citation: Yuanze Li, Topological Surface Charge Detection via Active Capacitive Compensation: A Pathway to the 4D Quantum Hall Effect, Physical Review Letters (2026), DOI:10.1103/wycz-5hvd

assessment: Ineligible. The source supports the relaxation-time formula and the four compensation-ratio settings, but the card combines the 0.5 T sweep conductance with a top-gate capacitance from a separate coercive-field geometric-area calibration. For the fixed 0.5 T condition asserted by the card, the source's impedance fit reports C_TG=1.506 nF, not 1.559 nF. Consequently the submitted parameter set does not describe the stated experimental condition and its deterministic central relaxation times are not source-supported.

issues.detail: The card fixes the 0.5 T, sigma_xx=2.35e-8 S sweep but uses C_TG=1.559 nF from the separate coercive-field area-ratio calibration (lines 897–940). The condition-matched impedance fit reports C_TG=1.506±0.001 nF at 0.5 T (lines 858–888).
